Cek Outlier¶

In [270]:
num_cols = ['Nominal Klaim Yang Disetujui', 'Nominal Biaya RS Yang Terjadi']
display(df[num_cols].describe().round(2).T)

print("\nInspeksi Outlier (Nilai Maksimum vs Persentil ke-75):")
for col in num_cols:
    q3 = df[col].quantile(0.75)
    maks = df[col].max()
    rasio = maks / q3
    print(f"- {col}:")
    print(f"  Q3 (75% data) = Rp {q3:,.2f}")
    print(f"  Nilai Max     = Rp {maks:,.2f}")
    print(f"  Nilai Max adalah {rasio:,.1f}x lipat dari batas Q3!")
    sns.boxplot(data=df[col])
    plt.show()

Data Cleansing¶

Hapus Spasi¶

In [271]:
df_clean = df.copy()
kategorik_cols = ['Reimburse/Cashless', 'Inpatient/Outpatient', 'Lokasi RS',
                  'Status Klaim', 'Plan Code', 'Gender', 'Domisili', 
                  'ICD Diagnosis', 'ICD Description']

for col in kategorik_cols:
    if df_clean[col].dtype == 'object':
        df_clean[col] = df_clean[col].str.strip().str.upper()

Ganti Missing Value¶

In [272]:
missing_cat_cols = ['Inpatient/Outpatient', 'ICD Diagnosis', 'ICD Description', 'Lokasi RS', 'Tanggal Pembayaran Klaim']

for col in missing_cat_cols:
    if col != 'Tanggal Pembayaran Klaim': 
        df_clean[col] = df_clean[col].fillna('UNKNOWN')

Parse tipe data¶

In [273]:
# (YYYY-MM-DD)
date_cols_standard = ['Tanggal Pembayaran Klaim', 'Tanggal Pasien Masuk RS', 'Tanggal Pasien Keluar RS']
for col in date_cols_standard:
    df_clean[col] = pd.to_datetime(df_clean[col], errors='coerce')

# Format Integer (YYYYMMDD)
df_clean['Tanggal Lahir'] = pd.to_datetime(df_clean['Tanggal Lahir'], format='%Y%m%d', errors='coerce')
df_clean['Tanggal Efektif Polis'] = pd.to_datetime(df_clean['Tanggal Efektif Polis'], format='%Y%m%d', errors='coerce')

Transformasi pakai Log Transform¶

In [275]:
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
In [276]:
# NOTE: Pakai log1p (log(1 + x)) buat hindari error kalau ada klaim yang 0
df_clean['Log_Nominal_Klaim'] = np.log1p(df_clean['Nominal Klaim Yang Disetujui'])
df_clean['Log_Biaya_RS'] = np.log1p(df_clean['Nominal Biaya RS Yang Terjadi'])
In [277]:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15, 6))

# Buat Grafik awal
sns.histplot(df_clean['Nominal Klaim Yang Disetujui'], bins=50, kde=True, ax=axes[0], color='crimson')
axes[0].set_title('Sebelum)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Nominal Klaim (Rupiah)')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Frekuensi')

# Buat Grafik sesudah
sns.histplot(df_clean['Log_Nominal_Klaim'], bins=50, kde=True, ax=axes[1], color='seagreen')
axes[1].set_title('Sesudah', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Log Nominal Klaim')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Frekuensi')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Buat fitur usia pas claim¶

In [280]:
df_clean['Usia_Saat_Klaim'] = df_clean['Tanggal Pasien Masuk RS'].dt.year - df_clean['Tanggal Lahir'].dt.year

Buat fitur tenure¶

In [281]:
# hitung selisih bulan (Tenure)
df_clean['Tenure_Bulan'] = (
    (df_clean['Tanggal Pasien Masuk RS'].dt.year - df_clean['Tanggal Efektif Polis'].dt.year) * 12 +
    (df_clean['Tanggal Pasien Masuk RS'].dt.month - df_clean['Tanggal Efektif Polis'].dt.month)
)

print("Berhasil menghitung Tenure_Bulan!")
display(df_clean[['Tanggal Efektif Polis', 'Tanggal Pasien Masuk RS', 'Tenure_Bulan']].head())

Canvas¶

In [285]:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="Set2")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analisis Faktor Pendorong Severitas dan Frekuensi Klaim', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# PLOT 1: BOXPLOT (Inpatient/Outpatient vs Severitas)
sns.boxplot(data=df_clean, x='Inpatient/Outpatient', y='Log_Nominal_Klaim', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='pastel')
axes[0, 0].set_title('1. Severitas Berdasarkan Tipe Perawatan (Box Plot)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Tipe Perawatan')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Log Nominal Klaim')

# PLOT 2: SCATTER PLOT (Length of Stay vs Severitas)
# Filter LoS > 0 biar scatter plot keliatan polanya buat pasien rawat inap
df_inpatient = df_clean[df_clean['Length_of_Stay'] > 0]
sns.scatterplot(data=df_inpatient, x='Length_of_Stay', y='Log_Nominal_Klaim', 
                hue='Inpatient/Outpatient', alpha=0.6, ax=axes[0, 1])
axes[0, 1].set_title('2. Dampak Lama Rawat (LoS) terhadap Severitas (Scatter Plot)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Length of Stay (Hari)')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Log Nominal Klaim')

# PLOT 3: BAR CHART (Usia vs Frekuensi Klaim)
# Binning usia
df_clean['Grup_Usia'] = pd.cut(df_clean['Usia_Saat_Klaim'], bins=[0, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 100], 
                               labels=['<20', '21-30', '31-40', '41-50', '51-60', '>60'])
freq_usia = df_clean['Grup_Usia'].value_counts().sort_index()

sns.barplot(x=freq_usia.index, y=freq_usia.values, ax=axes[1, 0], palette='viridis')
axes[1, 0].set_title('3. Frekuensi Klaim Berdasarkan Kelompok Usia (Bar Chart)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Kelompok Usia (Tahun)')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Jumlah Klaim')

# PLOT 4: HEATMAP (Korelasi Matriks Antar Fitur Numerik)
num_features = ['Log_Nominal_Klaim', 'Log_Biaya_RS', 'Usia_Saat_Klaim', 'Tenure_Bulan', 'Length_of_Stay']
korelasi = df_clean[num_features].corr()

sns.heatmap(korelasi, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', fmt=".2f", linewidths=0.5, ax=axes[1, 1], vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 1].set_title('4. Peta Korelasi Fitur Numerik (Heatmap)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Hapus kolom Grup_Usia krn cuma buat visualisasi bentar doang
df_clean.drop(columns=['Grup_Usia'], inplace=True)

Data Preparation and Encoding¶

Feature Selection¶

kolom_buang = [
    'Claim ID', 'Nomor Polis', # ID gaperlu di prediksi

]

df_ml = df_clean.drop(columns=kolom_buang)

import pandas as pd

import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from xgboost import XGBRegressor
from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor

from sklearn.ensemble import StackingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_absolute_percentage_error

Agregasi¶

In [290]:
df_freq = df_clean.groupby('Nomor Polis').agg(
    Frekuensi_Klaim=('Claim ID', 'count'),
    Usia_Saat_Klaim=('Usia_Saat_Klaim', 'max'), 
    Tenure_Bulan=('Tenure_Bulan', 'max'),       
    Plan_Code=('Plan Code', 'first'),
    Gender=('Gender', 'first'),
    Domisili=('Domisili', 'first')
).reset_index()

Pisahin prediktor dan fitur, serta split data¶

In [291]:
y_freq = df_freq['Frekuensi_Klaim']
X_freq = df_freq.drop(columns=['Nomor Polis', 'Frekuensi_Klaim'])

kolom_kategorik_freq = X_freq.select_dtypes(include=['object', 'category']).columns.tolist()
X_freq_encoded = pd.get_dummies(X_freq, columns=kolom_kategorik_freq, drop_first=True)

X_train_f, X_test_f, y_train_f, y_test_f = train_test_split(X_freq_encoded, y_freq, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

Stacked Model buat Frequency¶

In [292]:
# Pakainya poisson
base_models_freq = [
    ('xgb', XGBRegressor(random_state=42, n_estimators=150, learning_rate=0.05, max_depth=5, objective='count:poisson')),
    ('lgbm', LGBMRegressor(random_state=42, n_estimators=150, learning_rate=0.05, max_depth=5, objective='poisson', verbose=-1))
]

Meta Model buat Frequency¶

stacked_freq_model = StackingRegressor(
    estimators=base_models_freq,
    final_estimator=meta_model_freq,

)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.tsa.holtwinters import ExponentialSmoothing

Pastiin data siap¶

In [308]:
df_ts = df_trend.copy()
df_ts['Bulan_Tahun'] = pd.to_datetime(df_ts['Bulan_Tahun'])
df_ts.set_index('Bulan_Tahun', inplace=True)
df_ts = df_ts.sort_index()

df_ts = df_ts.asfreq('MS')

Time Series buat Total Claim¶

In [309]:
jumlah_bulan_prediksi = 17 

model_freq = ExponentialSmoothing(df_ts['Claim_Frequency'], trend='add', seasonal=None, initialization_method="estimated")
fit_freq = model_freq.fit()
forecast_freq = fit_freq.forecast(steps=jumlah_bulan_prediksi)

model_sev = ExponentialSmoothing(df_ts['Claim_Severity'], trend='add', seasonal=None, initialization_method="estimated")
fit_sev = model_sev.fit()
forecast_sev = fit_sev.forecast(steps=jumlah_bulan_prediksi)
forecast_total = forecast_freq * forecast_sev

bulan_prediksi = pd.date_range(start='2025-08-01', periods=jumlah_bulan_prediksi, freq='MS').strftime('%Y-%m').tolist()
df_proyeksi = pd.DataFrame({
    'Month': bulan_prediksi,
    'Claim_Frequency': np.round(forecast_freq.values).astype(int), 
    'Claim_Severity': forecast_sev.values,
    'Total_Claim': forecast_total.values
})

    bulan = bulan.replace("-", "_")

    submission_rows.append({'id': f"{bulan}_Claim_Severity", 'value': row['Claim_Severity']})
